context.body: Gospel, Israel, and shared life · Romans 14:13–23
context.label: Gospel, Israel, and shared life

observations.body: Liberty yields before stumbling and conscience. Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling. But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

payload.posture: Read Romans 14:13–23 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states liberty yields before stumbling and conscience. Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
